name: Innai Kansen ~Mayonaka no Nurse Call~
original_name: 淫内感染 ～真夜中のナースコール～
source:
Game goes in parallel with original Innai Kansen and includes two new characters. Clearing stages in action game reveals naughty images and small pieces of drama depicting sex scenes.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-september-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
本作与原版《淫内感染》的剧情平行展开，并加入了两名新角色。在动作游戏中通过关卡后，会解锁色情图片和描绘性爱场面的短篇剧情。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-september-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
